name: FIB-4 Index
template:
FIB-4 Index (Fibrosis-4)

Non-invasive assessment of liver fibrosis

Normal: 10-40 U/L
Normal: 7-56 U/L
Normal: 150-400 ×10⁹/L
Formula: FIB-4 = (Age × AST) / (Platelets × √ALT)
Interpretation:
• <1.30: Low risk of advanced fibrosis (F3-F4) - NPV 90%
• 1.30-2.67: Indeterminate - consider further testing
• >2.67: High risk of advanced fibrosis - PPV 80%
Note: Less accurate in patients <35 or >65 years
